scientific limitations/integrity: The theorem classifies the complete family of one-frequency-deletion magnitude measurements on the zero-mean subspace of a finite cyclic group. It proves injectivity up to global phase exactly for odd orders at least 5, but does not give noise-stability bounds, minimal deletion subfamilies, or a classification for noncyclic finite abelian groups. Finite exact computation is used only as a replay check; the universal result is analytic.
title: Frequency-deletion phase retrieval on cyclic groups: exact odd-order classification
